description: Optimize kmeans solver for maximum speedup over AlgoTune reference implementation

solution_format.description: Python file defining a Solver class with a solve(self, problem) method

example_structure.requirements: Must return a valid solution that passes task.is_solution()

optimization_strategies.name: algorithm_replacement
optimization_strategies.description: Replace naive algorithms with faster alternatives (e.g., Strassen for matrix multiply, iterative vs recursive)
optimization_strategies.hint: Look for O(n^3) operations that could be O(n^2.37) or better

optimization_strategies.name: vectorization
optimization_strategies.description: Use NumPy/SciPy vectorized operations instead of Python loops
optimization_strategies.hint: Replace for-loops with np.einsum, broadcasting, or scipy.linalg calls

optimization_strategies.name: jit_compilation
optimization_strategies.description: Use Numba @jit or Cython for hot loops
optimization_strategies.hint: Numba nopython mode for numerical kernels; cache=True for persistence

optimization_strategies.name: library_backends
optimization_strategies.description: Use optimized library backends (LAPACK, FFTW, etc.) via SciPy
optimization_strategies.hint: scipy.linalg often faster than numpy.linalg; check for specialized solvers

optimization_strategies.name: caching_precomputation
optimization_strategies.description: Cache repeated computations, precompute constants in __init__
optimization_strategies.hint: Move problem-independent setup to Solver.__init__(); use functools.lru_cache

optimization_strategies.name: mathematical_shortcuts
optimization_strategies.description: Exploit mathematical properties to skip computation
optimization_strategies.hint: Symmetry, sparsity, low-rank structure, analytical solutions for special cases

constraints: Solution MUST define 'class Solver' with a 'solve(self, problem)' method
Solution MUST pass task.is_solution() for ALL test inputs
Solution MUST be a single Python file (solver.py)
Available libraries: numpy, scipy, numba, cython, networkx, cvxpy, pulp, or-tools, sympy, jax, torch
No subprocess calls, no file I/O, no network access
No modifying the evaluation harness or timing infrastructure
Solution must terminate within 5 minutes per problem instance
